methodologyNotes: Prices collected by fetching official vendor pricing pages and confirmed US store pages. Official NVIDIA GeForce Now pricing pages (nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/plans/) returned 404 on all variants; prices sourced from Wikipedia GeForce Now article (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GeForce_Now), confirmed by NVIDIA's own page referencing 'Performance' and 'Ultimate' tiers with a '35% off 12-month' promo live as of 2026-06-14. Xbox Cloud Gaming prices sourced from the live Xbox Microsoft Store product pages which rendered actual USD figures. PlayStation Plus cloud-streaming prices sourced from the official playstation.com/en-us/ps-plus/ page. Amazon Luna pricing sourced from TechCrunch's October 23, 2025 article covering the service revamp (luna.amazon.com redirects to luna.amazon.de in this environment — US page geolocated away). Shadow PC pricing sourced from the official US offers page (shadow.tech/us/shadowpc/offers/) which rendered full USD prices. Boosteroid's official site (boosteroid.com) geolocated to EUR pricing only in this environment; no USD self-serve price could be confirmed — monthlyUsd set to null per methodology. All minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall set to null (non-telephony vertical). annualDiscountPct calculated where both monthly and annual prices are published. accessedAt: 2026-06-14.

vendors.name: NVIDIA GeForce NOW
vendors.provenance: Official pricing pages (nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/plans/, /memberships/, /premium-memberships/) all returned 404 as of 2026-06-14. NVIDIA main page (nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/) loaded but prices JS-rendered and absent from HTML. Fell back to Wikipedia GeForce Now article (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GeForce_Now) which lists Performance at $9.99/mo and $99.99/yr, Ultimate at $19.99/mo and $199.99/yr, and Day Passes at $3.99 (Performance) and $7.99 (Ultimate). NVIDIA's own page corroborates tier names ('Performance' and 'Ultimate') and confirms a '35% off 12-month Performance or Ultimate membership' promotion valid through July 8, 2026.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1-hour gaming sessions per session, ad-supported queue, up to 1080p/60fps. Requires own game library (Steam, Epic, GOG, etc.). No credit card required.

plans.name: Performance — Monthly
plans.notes: 6-hour gaming sessions, priority queue, up to 1440p/60fps. Formerly called 'Priority'. As of January 1, 2026 a 100-hour/month cap applies; extra 15-hour blocks cost $2.99 each. Day Pass also available at $3.99 for 24-hour access.

plans.name: Performance — Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $99.99/yr ($8.33/mo effective). Month-to-month rate is $9.99/mo; ~17% discount vs monthly. A 35% promotional discount on 12-month Performance was active through July 8, 2026 per NVIDIA's site.

plans.name: Ultimate — Monthly
plans.notes: 8-hour sessions, RTX 4080-class server GPU, up to 4K/120fps or 1080p/240fps, lowest queue times. 100-hour/month cap as of January 1, 2026; extra 15-hour blocks cost $5.99 each. Day Pass at $7.99 for 24-hour access.

plans.name: Ultimate — Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $199.99/yr ($16.67/mo effective). Month-to-month rate is $19.99/mo; ~17% discount vs monthly. A 35% promotional discount on 12-month Ultimate was active through July 8, 2026 per NVIDIA's site.

vendors.name: Xbox Cloud Gaming
vendors.provenance: Primary source: official Xbox Microsoft Store product page (xbox.com/en-US/games/store/game-pass-ultimate/cfq7ttc0khs0) fetched 2026-06-14 — rendered actual USD prices: Ultimate $22.99/mo, Premium $14.99/mo, Essential $9.99/mo, PC Game Pass $13.99/mo. Wikipedia Xbox Game Pass article (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xbox_Game_Pass) corroborates the tier structure and confirms an April 21, 2026 price reduction for Ultimate and PC Game Pass; the pricing table in Wikipedia shows $9.99/$14.99/$22.99/$13.99 which matches live store values. Cloud gaming (xCloud) is available on Essential, Premium, and Ultimate tiers; PC Game Pass does not include console cloud streaming.

plans.name: Game Pass Essential
plans.notes: 50+ games, cloud gaming included (xCloud), online multiplayer. Renamed from 'Core' on October 1, 2025. No day-one titles. First month $1 promotional offer. Cloud gaming stream quality up to 1080p/60fps.

plans.name: Game Pass Premium
plans.notes: 200+ games, cloud gaming included, new Xbox-published titles within 1 year of launch (not day-one). Renamed from 'Standard' on October 1, 2025. First 14 days $1 promotional offer.

plans.name: Game Pass Ultimate
plans.notes: 500+ games, cloud gaming, day-one releases (excluding Call of Duty as of April 21, 2026), EA Play included, Ubisoft+ Classics. Raised to $29.99 on October 1, 2025; reduced to $22.99 on April 21, 2026 when day-one Call of Duty access was removed.

plans.name: PC Game Pass
plans.notes: 300+ PC games, day-one PC titles, EA Play on PC included. Does not include console cloud streaming (xCloud); PC game streaming requires a compatible device and the Xbox app. First 14 days $1 promotional offer.

vendors.name: Amazon Luna
vendors.provenance: Primary source: TechCrunch article (techcrunch.com, October 23, 2025) covering Amazon Luna's October 2025 revamp — confirmed Luna Premium at $9.99/mo and free tier for Amazon Prime members. Official luna.amazon.com redirects to luna.amazon.de (German site) in this environment; direct US pricing page inaccessible due to geo-redirect. Wikipedia Amazon Luna article (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Luna) corroborates Luna's existence as of June 2026 but only lists historical $5.99 early-access price without current figures. TechCrunch remains the most recent authoritative English-language source with explicit USD pricing post-October 2025 revamp.

plans.name: Luna for Prime Members
plans.notes: Included with Amazon Prime at no additional charge. Access to GameNight (25+ local multiplayer titles) and a rotating selection of standard games. Requires active Amazon Prime membership (Prime itself costs $14.99/mo or $139/yr).

plans.name: Luna Premium
plans.notes: Expanded game library including EA SPORTS FC 25, Star Wars Jedi: Survivor, Batman: Arkham Knight, and 100+ additional titles beyond the Prime-included selection. Formerly called 'Luna+'. Renamed and revamped October 2025.

vendors.name: Shadow PC
vendors.provenance: Primary source: official US Shadow PC offers page (shadow.tech/us/shadowpc/offers/) fetched 2026-06-14 — returned USD pricing: Neo at $37.99/mo (introductory $30.39 for first 3 months) and Power at $54.99/mo. This page was fetched twice in separate calls and returned identical prices both times. Shadow's German site (shadow.tech/de/pro/offers/) and the generic shadow.tech/offers page both returned EUR prices for the Shadow Pro (professional workstation) product — different product from the Shadow PC gaming plan.

plans.name: Neo
plans.notes: Entry-level full cloud Windows PC for gaming. RTX-class GPU, suitable for 1080p gaming. No commitment (cancel anytime). Introductory rate of $30.39 for first 3 months for new subscribers as of 2026-06-14 (represents approximately 20% off). Install games from Steam, Epic, Battle.net, EA App.

plans.name: Power
plans.notes: Up to 50% more GPU power than Neo. Suitable for 1440p/4K gaming and content creation. No commitment (cancel anytime). Full cloud Windows PC — not a game streaming library; user installs own games.

vendors.name: PlayStation Plus (Premium cloud streaming tier)
vendors.provenance: Primary source: official PlayStation Plus page (playstation.com/en-us/ps-plus/) fetched 2026-06-14 — returned full USD pricing for all three tiers. Only the Premium tier includes cloud game streaming; Essential and Extra are included here for context as they are pre-requisite tiers. Corroboration: Wikipedia PlayStation Plus article confirmed tier structure (though did not list prices in the extracted content).

plans.name: Essential — Monthly
plans.notes: No cloud streaming. Online multiplayer, 2–3 monthly free games, exclusive discounts, 100 GB cloud saves. Included as base tier context.

plans.name: Extra — Monthly
plans.notes: No cloud streaming. Adds Game Catalog (hundreds of PS4/PS5 titles download-to-play) and Ubisoft+ Classics on top of Essential benefits.

plans.name: Premium — Monthly
plans.notes: Cloud streaming enabled (stream PS3 titles and select PS4/PS5 games without download). Adds Classics Catalog (PS1/PS2/PSP/PS3 titles), game trials, cloud streaming, and Sony Pictures Catalog on top of Extra benefits. Cloud streaming only available on Premium tier.

plans.name: Premium — Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $159.99/yr ($13.33/mo effective). Month-to-month rate is $19.99/mo; ~33% discount vs monthly. All Premium cloud-streaming features included.

vendors.name: Boosteroid
vendors.provenance: Official boosteroid.com site and cloud.boosteroid.com both fetched 2026-06-14. All pricing pages (boosteroid.com/en/pricing, /plans, /subscription, /subscription-plans, /order, cloud.boosteroid.com/subscription, cloud.boosteroid.com/plans) returned 404. The homepage (boosteroid.com) loaded and displays EUR-only pricing: 'Ultra Pro' at €14.89/mo (promotional €8.97/mo) and 'from €7.49/month with annual subscription' for entry tier. USD self-serve pricing is not confirmed from this environment (server geolocates to EUR). Per methodology, monthlyUsd set to null — null is better than a currency-converted guess. Tier names ('Basic'/'Start' and 'Ultra Pro') inferred from homepage language; exact plan names not confirmed from pricing page.

plans.name: Standard (annual)
plans.notes: Entry-tier cloud gaming subscription. Homepage shows 'from €7.49/month with annual subscription' (EUR only; USD not confirmed from this environment). 1080p streaming, own game library required. Exact plan name unconfirmed from pricing page (all pricing sub-pages returned 404).

plans.name: Ultra Pro
plans.notes: Top-tier plan. Homepage shows €14.89/mo (promotional €8.97/mo as of 2026-06-14) in EUR only; USD not confirmed from this environment. Higher resolution and frame-rate streaming vs Standard tier.
